text: From Influx Development, welcome to this sweet contemporary Craftsman cottage in Whittier Heights. Sunny main floor includes open concept living, dining and kitchen for both effortless entertaining and functional everyday living. Powder room offers simplicity for guests and hosting. Upstairs, relax in your spacious primary suite with two additional bedrooms or offices, full bath and dedicated laundry. Attached EV-ready garage finishes this beautifully appointed home. This central neighborhood allows access to the outdoors and recreation, with Shilshole, Golden Gardens, and the Burke-Gilman all within reach, plus dining options abound and top-rated schools are all accessible within blocks.

Timeless charm meets thoughtful modern design on a quiet street in beloved Loyal Heights. A crisp white exterior, charming awnings, a rose-lined entry & fenced front yard offers a warm welcome. Inside, a generous, sun-filled living rm anchored by a stone FP adjoins the dining which rests within walls of windows filtering gorgeous natural light. Beautifully appointed kitchen pairs timeless cabinetry w striking stone that flows from counters to backsplash, while a distinctive stone-clad island plus pantry add character & everyday functionality. Pass through the light-filled hallway leading to the bedroom wing w an expansive slider offering private deck access - a special space for lingering gatherings under twinkling lights. Serene primary retreat w its own FP, spacious walk-in & 5-piece bath layered w marble, custom tile & a warm oak dbl vanity. 5th bed offers flexibility for office or additional living space. Downstairs, tall ceilings, new finishes & a tiled FP make the lower level feel equally inviting, w 2 more beds & a new full bath where rich burgundy tile brings depth alongside marble floors. New electrical, plumbing & more plus a thoughtfully redesigned layout & curated fixtures bring lasting value, while a detached garage w alley access adds convenience. 1 year home warranty provided! From afternoons at Loyal Heights Playfield to sunsets at beach walks at Golden Gardens, plus award-winning schools, this is a home that invites you to settle in & savor the neighborhood.

Exceptional financing opportunity! The builder has secured the BEST and most competitive rate lock, 4.875%! Inquire with listing agents for details. Experience elevated NW living in this stunning new home by AM Homes Northwest, ideally located in coveted Sunset Hills. This light-filled 4-bed, 2.5-bath home features an open layout w/expansive windows that showcase spectacular Pacific NW views while filling the home with natural light. Rooftop entertaining terrace, with a wet bar & beverage refrigerator, creates an unforgettable space for relaxing & hosting. The chef's kitchen offers luxury Bellmont cabinetry, Bertazzoni gas range, a spacious pantry, & an oversized island designed for gathering. The private top-floor primary suite captures breathtaking Mount Rainier & Space Needle views, while the spa-inspired bath features heated tile floors. An additional third-floor bedroom is ideal for a home office or guests. Additional highlights include a fully fenced & landscaped yard, whole-house air conditioning, designated parking w/EV charging, & the exceptional craftsmanship AM Homes Northwest is known for while including a 4-year builder warranty, & a transferable insured 2-10 structural warranty. Minutes from Ballard's acclaimed restaurants, boutique shopping, the Ballard Farmers Market, Golden Gardens Beach, Shilshole Bay Marina, & convenient transit, this home offers exceptional design, remarkable views, & one of Seattle's most desirable locations

Wonderful opportunity in Sunset Hill to own this large 5100+ square foot corner lot with an alley in back. Current home is a 1909 Craftsman with 2 bedrooms and 1 bath, living room, dining room, kitchen with breakfast nook, plus unfinished basement and attic. Much of the original character has been retained in the box beam ceilings, millwork, built-ins with stained glass, and original wood flooring. This beautiful lot has plenty of space to bring your imagination and plans for a future home in west Ballard. Don't miss out on this unbeatable location near all Ballard has to offer: close to the Ballard Locks, Adams Elementary, Golden Gardens, the National Nordic Museum, and all there is to experience in downtown Ballard, from the year-round Sunday farmer's market and excellent shopping, to the plentiful restaurants, cafes, music venues and many more neighborhood amenities! Property sold AS IS - estate sale.

Breathtaking views of the Olympic Mountains & Puget Sound overwhelm this west-facing, Sunset Hill craftsman home. Situated on a spacious, corner lot, 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms span across 3 levels, including an unfinished basement w/endless potential. Beautifully restored hardwoods, charming built-ins, elegant cove ceilings & classic archways honor the home's timeless character, while updated systems offer modern-day comfort and peace of mind. Expansive living room windows frame the snow-capped peaks & shimmering water, while a cozy, gas fireplace invites you to settle in and savor the moment. A covered porch, positioned off the formal dining room & kitchen, offers an idyllic setting for watching the evening skies over the Sound transform at sunset. Rounding out the main level are two generous bedrooms and a full bath. Upstairs, 2 additional bedrooms offer their own distinctive charm- one showcasing spectacular views, while the other boasts soaring vaulted ceilings & skylights bathing the room in natural light. Higher ceilings in the unfinished basement provide an opportunity to create additional living spaces: rec room, guest suite, home gym? A fully-fenced backyard offers plenty of room for entertaining, gardening or playing + a 1 car garage w/ storage & driveway parking. Sunset Hill offers an exceptionally walkable lifestyle, with neighborhood restaurants, cozy coffee shops, beautiful parks, and convenient public transportation just blocks away. Welcome Home!

Discover timeless Seattle charm and exceptional versatility in this inviting Sunset Hill residence! Offering over 2,000 square feet of finished living space, this classic 1941 home blends character, comfort, and an enviable location in one of Ballard's most desirable neighborhoods. The updated kitchen brings modern convenience to everyday living, while generous gathering spaces offer room to relax, entertain, and work from home. A welcoming living room anchored by a beautiful fireplace creates an inviting setting for quiet evenings or lively get-togethers. Downstairs, the finished lower level adds valuable flexibility for recreation, hobbies, guests, or a home office. Three bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations, and the thoughtful layout offers opportunities to personalize the home to suit your lifestyle. Situated on an approximately 5,700-square-foot lot, the property offers outdoor space for gardening, entertaining, and enjoying the Pacific Northwest seasons. Just minutes from Golden Gardens Park, Sunset Hill Park, Ballard Locks, vibrant restaurants and shops, cafes, local markets, and the popular Ballard Farmers Market. Enjoy waterfront recreation, scenic sunsets, and convenient connections to downtown Seattle and surrounding neighborhoods. Whether you're drawn to the updated kitchen, flexible finished living areas, or sought-after Sunset Hill setting, this home delivers a compelling combination of space, charm, and location. Your next chapter starts here!

Soaring ceilings, graceful arches and sunshine - this 1910 Craftsman knows how to make an entrance! A covered front porch overlooks a fenced, south-facing yard ready for gardening, gatherings and fur babies. Inside, a proper entry and gorgeous hardwoods welcome you into beautifully connected living spaces. Large living room windows bring in abundant natural light, making it easy to settle in with coffee and a good book. Whip up meals in the sunny kitchen with butcher block counters, under-cabinet lighting, stainless appliances and a crisp subway tile backsplash. A generous dining room for hosting loved ones and a full bath complete the main floor. Upstairs you'll find three bedrooms, each with a walk-in closet, plus mini-splits for year-round comfort. A stunning 3/4 bath features heated floors, marble tile and under-cabinet lighting. The finished lower level offers a fourth bedroom, bonus room, laundry room, and half bath. Rest easy knowing major systems have been brought into the new century: updated electrical, plumbing, double-pane windows, and a heat pump. Tucked into Ballard's coveted West Woodland neighborhood, this unbeatable location puts the best of Ballard, Phinney Ridge and Fremont at your fingertips, from fav coffee shops, dining hotspots, and breweries, to parks and farmers markets. Ditch the car for everyday errands and enjoy an easy-breezy bike or bus commute downtown.

Views, charm, livability, convenience, all in one attractive home. Multiple west-facing decks deliver a commanding perspective over Ballard with the Olympic Mountains as a backdrop, the perfect setting for watching the seasons change. Inside, 1926 character meets thoughtful updates. The front room features a perfect-blue color wash, period wood-burning fireplace and built-ins, and open dining room with plentiful windows and stylish lighting. The remodeled kitchen is efficient and bespoke, with quartz counters, white shaker cabinetry, subway tile, stainless appliances, a Fisher & Paykel range, and a sunny breakfast nook with heated terracotta floor. Two bedrooms and a full bath complete the main level. Upstairs, find a generous primary bedroom with ensuite bath and a guest bedroom with built-in shelving and westerly view; this could double as an office space. The finished lower level adds valuable bonus space for a rec room, media room, home office, or play area. Outside, a fully fenced yard with patio, pergola, and terraced garden invites easy outdoor living. Just steps to West Woodland Elementary and a few blocks to the shops, restaurants, and pubs of Ballard and Phinney Ridge, this is a laid-back Seattle neighborhood where life happens outdoors and neighbors know each other.

Beach club membership not required. The water is yours and the afternoon changes shape. At 647 NW 51st Street, a private swimming pool turns a classic Ballard home into The Frelard Pool House, enriched by a cabana and dressing area, private guest suite, wet bar, entertaining spaces and indoor sauna. Behind the laughter, wet feet and one-more-swim afternoons, the house keeps everything grounded. Living spaces hold the daily pattern. Bedrooms give everyone a place to land. The kitchen anchors movement between living, dining and the backyard. Lower-level spaces add flexibility for guests, work, play or longer stays. The supporting spaces keep the day going. The cabana and dressing area give pool days a proper landing zone: a place to change, drop a bag, reset between swims and stay outside longer. The wet bar keeps drinks, snacks and conversation close to the action. The guest suite gives visitors a reason to stay, and the indoor sauna brings warmth and comfort into colder months. Near the meeting point of Ballard, Fremont, Phinney and Greenwood, The Frelard Pool House keeps restaurants, breweries, parks, errands and transit close, while giving home its own reason to gather. A classic Seattle house with a way of living rarely found in the city.

Storybook Tudor Charm in the Heart of Ballard. Nestled on a picturesque street filled with Old World charm and character, this enchanting 1931 Tudor welcomes you with timeless architectural details and distinctive craftsmanship. Inside, discover quarter-sawn oak floors, graceful archways, coved ceilings, an Art Deco fireplace, original millwork, mahogany doors, vintage hardware, and light-catching crystal doorknobs. The home offers two bedrooms plus an office, providing flexibility for working from home or creating a cozy personal retreat. Outside, a generous lot offers a private backyard and inviting patio, complete with raised garden beds-a peaceful oasis in the heart of the city. Enjoy the best of the Ballard lifestyle, with the famous Ballard Farmers Market, neighborhood shops, restaurants, and transit all within walking distance. Recent improvements include a new roof and gutters installed in 2025 and new interior paint throughout. An energy-efficient heat pump provides year-round comfort, with the added benefit of air conditioning. Non-conforming 3rd bedroom & large utility room with 2nd-bath conversion potential. A rare opportunity to own a distinctive. And apparently, the backyard has caught the attention of a local celebrity! Jimothy, the neighborhood's much-loved raccoon, has made an appearance on the Ring camera. Clearly, he has excellent taste in real estate.

A beautifully restored 1927 Tudor behind the gates of Seattle's coveted Broadmoor community, where tree-lined streets and distinctive homes surround the fairways of Broadmoor Golf Club. Classic brickwork, steep gables and a welcoming entry introduce interiors rich in architectural detail. Graceful archways, leaded-glass windows and a sweeping staircase pair with meticulously refinished hardwoods and freshly painted interiors. The light-filled living room features a Rumford fireplace and French doors to a covered garden terrace. An elegant formal dining room complements the kitchen's marble counters, premium range, herringbone porcelain floors and inviting breakfast nook. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a wood-burning fireplace, generous custom walk-in closet and bath with a freestanding soaking tub. Four bedrooms and a finished lower level provide room for guests, work and recreation. Mature landscaping frames a private backyard with level lawn and patios. A/C, heated floors and a detached two-car garage with EV charging complete the home. A peaceful retreat just minutes from Madison Park's cafes, boutiques and Lake Washington shoreline, as well as the trails of the Washington Park Arboretum.

1902 Victorian in the Center of the Universe ~ Just about anything you could desire is within about a block of this turn-of-the-century residence in the heart of Seattle's vibrant Capitol Hill neighborhood. Light Rail station, tram, shopping, grocery, restaurants, coffee shops. right outside your door. RARE off-street parking for TWO vehicles behind a secure gate. Converted years ago to a LEGAL DUPLEX, this home presents many possibilities for use. Live in one unit and rent the other, or purchase as an investment and rent both. Perhaps you restore it to a single-family home and enjoy your private domicile nestled in amongst the bustle of apartments, condos, and businesses. Currently a short-term vacation rental, but has been successfully rented to long-term tenants for many years. If your budget keeps presenting you with cookie-cutter townhomes but your heart wants something a bit more interesting, this could be the Unicorn you've been seeking!

This 1903 Craftsman jewel box with mountain, city skyline and Space Needle views is on an excellent one-way Capitol Hill block directed away from Volunteer Park allowing for a serene, resident-only feel. The property's defining feature is its striking swooped-tail roof, which perfectly balances the elegant wide front porch and transitional columns. Enjoy rare curved bow windows, rich period millwork, beautiful heavy wooden pocket doors, charming window seats and an unusual and exquisite wood burning fireplace with deep green tile and hand forged iron hardware. Double doors in the dining room lead out to a beautiful patio, which also flows directly into the sunlit kitchen with breakfast bar, and wonderful eating nook. Upstairs features 3 bedrooms as well as a bonus classic sleeping porch. The high-ceilinged daylight basement includes an existing powder room, offering incredible expandable space. The property is complete with a detached garage and an ultra-private backyard, perfectly screened by a mature, tall laurel hedge. Experience an effortless urban lifestyle with nearby legendary local spots, from Macrina Bakery and Monsoon to Espresso Vivace.

Single-family living in North Capitol Hill offers a rare combination of privacy, space and exceptional city access. Inviting home pairs original hardwood floors and a fireplace with an open living/dining area designed for everyday living and entertaining. French doors open to a flexible bedroom, office or den. The updated kitchen impresses with quartz counters, custom storage, stainless appliances, gas cooking and double ovens. Retreat to a primary suite with 3/4 bath and abundant built-ins. Outside, a fully fenced backyard, expansive deck, mature shade tree and covered patio create a setting perfect for gatherings. Two alley-access parking spaces add convenience. Mini-split heating/AC plus major updates including roof, electrical panel, sewer line and water heater add peace of mind. Near parks, dining, groceries, transit and convenient Eastside connections.

Timeless Craftsman charm meets thoughtful modern updates in this well-maintained North Capitol Hill home. Built in 1909 and featured twice in Seattle Homes Magazine, this 4-bedroom, 3.75-bath home offers 4,120 sq ft showcasing carefully preserved architectural details and original character. The inviting kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a Mediterranean-style tile island and granite countertops. A sunroom addition creates a light-filled gathering space with access to the expansive back deck and private backyard. The primary suite features a stained-concrete bathroom with a Japanese soaking tub, a large closet and an expansive private deck. All bedrooms are generously sized with large closets. The loft-like upper level offers a spacious sitting room with view windows, two office spaces and a half bath. A charming reading alcove with built-in bookshelves conceals an adorable hidden playroom behind cabinet doors. Partial water and downtown Bellevue views add to this level's appeal. The fully finished basement includes a rec room, bedroom, a 3/4 bath and a large storage room. Abundant storage throughout. Updated plumbing and electrical throughout. Outside, the back deck invites you to relax or entertain, with a sunken fire pit concealed beneath removable decking. Detached one-car garage. Located just down the street from Seattle Prep and near Interlaken Park's wooded trails, Volunteer Park and neighborhood cafes. Centrally located with easy access to I-5 and SR 520.

Sweeping views of Lake Union, Puget Sound, the Olympic Mountains and downtown Seattle from a fully renovated North Capitol Hill residence. Interiors by The Phinery and approximately $600,000 in renovations, infrastructure and technology mean there is nothing left to do in this 3,400 SF contemporary home. The updated kitchen flows into a great room with radiant heated floors, opening to a tiled patio with a large gas fireplace. Every bathroom has been remodeled to the studs, with designer tile and custom cabinetry throughout, and the primary suite adds automated window shades. Built for resilience: a 10.56 kW solar array, Tesla Powerwall, natural gas fuel cell, SPAN smart panel, high-efficiency boiler, zoned heat pumps and HRV fresh air. Smart locks, camera and alarm systems, and Cat 6 wiring throughout. Garage with vehicle lift and epoxy floor, plus a separate street-level garage. A rooftop terrace and multiple decks frame Olympic sunsets.

A private retreat. A panoramic perspective. An exceptional expression of Seattle architecture. The Blaine Stairs Residences represent a distinctive expression of contemporary architecture, Designed by Seattle-based Mithun Design and masterfully built by Dovetail. Long list of remarkable features include an 8 person custom built in solid wood dining table and island, radiant heating system, spec built custom cabinets & dressers, sound rated floor to ceiling windows with custom bolting slider + automatic blinds, fireplace, Brazilian Ipe wood decks & balcony, Norwegian stone bathroom counters w/ embedded fossils, rain shower + soaking tub. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows frame captivating westerly views of Lake Union, the Seattle skyline, the Space Needle, and the Olympic Mountains, transforming every sunset into a private viewing experience. Upper level, the primary suite is a private sanctuary with dedicated office space, a sunset-facing deck, and a beautifully appointed primary bath. The lower level offers a guest bedroom and bath alongside a third bedroom or flexible-use space. Two designated parking spaces complete this distinctive residence, where architectural integrity, uncommon privacy, and extraordinary views converge. No HOA and a turnkey opportunity for owner occupants or investors for long-term rental income!

address: 1212 E Shelby St Apt 5, Seattle, WA
text: End-of-dock with uninterrupted views straight down the Montlake Cut, this rare front-row floating home offers the quintessential Seattle "houseboat" lifestyle. You own the moorage as a member of theco-op dock, complete with your own private boat slip, low-bank bulkhead waterfront, and two expansive decks designed for effortless outdoor entertaining, swimming, and launching your paddleboard. Inside, all-main-floor living features light-filled interiors, soaring vaulted ceilings, and gorgeous hardwood floors, all thoughtfully designed by architect Eric Hogeboom. The clever layout places the primary suite on its own with stunning water vistas and direct deck access, while two additional bedrooms sit on the opposite side of the home with dedicated bath space-all framed by brand-new windows ideal for taking in the summer boat parade or watching winter migratory birds. Freshly painted inside and out, packed with storage including an attic, and wrapped in panoramic views on three sides, this is an extraordinary opportunity to live right on the water.

Bold architecture, dramatic walls of glass and exceptional outdoor living define this striking modern masterpiece. Impeccably maintained by its original owner and presented in pristine condition, this stunning residence blends sophisticated design with effortless comfort and unforgettable entertaining spaces. The main level was designed for gathering, with soaring windows, sun-drenched interiors, seamless indoor-outdoor flow, sleek quartz countertops, refined finishes, a statement fireplace and beautifully connected living spaces. Expansive glass doors open from the chef's kitchen and family room to extraordinary outdoor spaces rarely found in newer construction. Two expansive back terraces offer room to lounge, dine, entertain and play, while the rooftop deck delivers sweeping views of Madison Park, Lake Washington, and the Bellevue skyline - the ultimate setting for sunset cocktails and unforgettable gatherings. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite is a private sanctuary with a spa-inspired bath, oversized windows, and a stunning terrace with gorgeous views. Two additional bedrooms and a full bath complete the upper level. The lower level offers a spacious 4th bedroom/office and a large media room, ideal for movie nights, gaming, or guests. Incredible outdoor spaces with five terraces. Attached garage, abundant storage, and space for a future elevator complete this rare offering. Walk to the Arboretum, Madison Valley shops and restaurants, Madison Park, and Lake Washington

Tucked quietly into one of Seattle's most beloved neighborhoods, this classic 1928 Tudor blends timeless character with everyday comfort. Sunlight fills the living room, where vaulted ceilings, hardwood floors, and a handsome fireplace create an inviting atmosphere. An updated kitchen, formal dining room, and flexible living spaces span three levels, including a charming upper suite with vaulted wood ceilings and skylights. Outside, a private, fenced yard and elevated deck offer a peaceful retreat, complemented by an alley-accessed, single-car garage. Enjoy walkable neighborhood cafes, restaurants, the Arboretum, and UW, with convenient connections to Capitol Hill, South Lake Union, downtown Seattle, and Bellevue via nearby SR 520.

**Luxury New Construction Presale in Madison Valley, Completion in AUGUST 2027!** Discover an exceptional blend of modern architecture, sophisticated design, and versatile living in this stunning 3,306 SQFT residence featuring 5 bedrooms, 4.25 bathrooms, and parking for two vehicles. Thoughtfully designed for both everyday comfort and elevated entertaining, the open concept main living area showcases a spacious chef inspired kitchen, expansive dining area, and inviting living room with a striking stone fireplace and custom built ins. A private studio suite with its own entrance, kitchen, and bathroom offers exceptional flexibility for guests, multigenerational living, or a home office. Upstairs, the elegant primary suite and additional bedrooms provide comfort and privacy. The showstopping rooftop retreat features a bonus living room, wet bar, and covered outdoor deck with views of the city, water, and mountains perfect for entertaining or unwinding. Ideally situated near Madison Park, the Washington Park Arboretum, Montlake, and Capitol Hill, with easy access to dining, shopping, and recreation. **Presale opportunity with potential to personalize select finishes, cabinetry, flooring, and fixtures depending on construction progress.** Experience luxury living tailored to your lifestyle.

Stunning fully updated waterfront Montlake charmer and a rare opportunity to own one of Seattle's most coveted waterfront homes! Unobstructed waterway views, large yard for entertaining & a front-row seat to year-round maritime activity define this exceptional home on the iconic Montlake Cut. Spacious 3,760 SF interior, originally built in 1925 & fully remodeled to blend timeless character with modern luxury. Unmatched commuter location, less than 10 minutes from downtown Bellevue & Seattle all while enjoying the serenity of waterfront living. Light-filled living spaces include formal living & dining rooms, a chef's kitchen with quartz countertops & Wolf, Bosch, and Fisher & Paykel appliances, plus a dedicated office. Upstairs features a luxurious primary suite with water views, spa-inspired bath & walk-in closet, plus 2 additional bedrooms. The lower level offers flexible recreation & family space with abundant storage. Multiple decks, patios & beautifully landscaped grounds provide exceptional indoor-outdoor living. Recent improvements include a new 50-year roof, A/C, floors, a new large tandem 2-car garage & refreshed landscaping. Steps to Seattle Yacht Club and minutes to UW, Husky Stadium & University Village.

BUYERS SPOKE. SELLER LISTENED: Grass-Paved Parking Pad (see conceptual plans in photos) to be installed as part of closing wired for EV. Around a 30K value add to this classic 1911 Montlake Craftsman, completely reimagined for modern living. 1743 26th Ave. E. retains the character of its original architecture while adding approximately 3,060 square feet of beautifully designed new space. The result is essentially a new 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath home with the quality and amenities of new construction. Inside, a contemporary aesthetic is complemented by oak hardwood floors and leaded-glass accents. The custom kitchen features designer finishes, top-of-the-line Bosch appliances, and a butler's pantry. Accordion doors open the kitchen and dining room to the expansive Ipe deck and level backyard, creating an effortless connection between the home and outdoors. With a den adjacent to the living room, a lower-level media room, and a generous utility room, there is flexibility for both daily living and working from home. Beyond the house, Montlake has something increasingly rare in Seattle: a true neighborhood. The 24th Avenue business district is just minutes away, with Fuel Coffee & Books, Oxbow, Cafe Lago, the library, and other shops and services creating an easy, walkable daily rhythm. The Montlake Community Center and Playfield provides another dimension to the community. At your front door is the Washington Park Arboretum. There is simply nothing like it on the market today.

Ideally-located view property in the quiet, leafy Arboretum neighborhood of East Capitol Hill. Renovate or redevelop this 2-level, 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home on a generous 5000 sq ft lot. On a charming side street of $2M+ homes, just blocks from Madison Valley's excellent restaurants, cafes, boutique shops, Washington Park Arboretum, and the new PCC grocery store. 88 WalkScore. Home offers territorial, Cascade mountain, and Bellevue city views from both floors - even better views unlocked by redeveloping to 3+ stories. Home is livable with a coat of paint - rent while you plan to redevelop. Zoned Neighborhood Residential inside a Frequent Transit Service Area and Major Transit Stop walkshed (no parking required). Blocks to express bus to downtown, 8, 11, 43, 48 buses. Lot measures 50' of street frontage x 100' deep. Seller-provided information includes title commitment, adjacent property survey, and consulting arborist report & tree inventory. Or, invest in a cosmetic rehab of this solid 1964 home, which features 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths on the main floor, oak hardwoods, views from the east-facing rooms, newer windows, primary with half bath and balcony, and copper plumbing. Downstairs, find a finished full-height daylight basement with French doors opening to a large deck and territorial views - perfect for future ADU or expansion potential. Two off-street driveway parking spots. Sold at land value. Please request arborist report and site information packet from listing agent.

text: 1641 Windermere Drive E. Distinguished 1927 Mediterranean Revival in gated Broadmoor, set on a rare street-to-street lot offering exceptional privacy and flexibility. Behind a mature privacy hedge and Japanese maple frame a wrought-iron gate hinting at the elegance within before the home ever comes into full view. A stone-paved courtyard and an elegant entry framed by fluted pilasters, art-glass sidelights welcome you home. Smooth cream stucco, deep charcoal trim, arched windows, a graceful wrought-iron balcony, Italian cypress and a storybook terracotta roofline create a timeless Old-World presence. Inside, over 5,000 square feet showcases beautifully preserved architectural detail, including carved plaster surrounds, arched French doors and distinctive ironwork. Thoughtfully updated with A/C, whole-home A/V, a 2,000-bottle wine cellar, outdoor kitchen and 2-car garage. The generous street-to-street lot offers rare potential for expanded gardens, motor court access or additional outdoor living. Established in 1924, Broadmoor remains one of Seattle's most private and sought-after enclaves, adjacent to Washington Park Arboretum and Madison Park. Nearly a century of architectural pedigree meets a coveted gated address.

Welcome Home to Harvard Avenue and this 4 Bedroom 2.25 Bath oasis on one of Seattle's most distinguished streets and sought after neighborhoods. Located in the Historic N. Cap Hill Belmont district, this expansive home fills with natural light & has; Hardwood Floors, oversized windows on all walls, mature landscaping, 2 car garage, 4 off street parking, curved staircase to front entry, crown moulding, tall ceilings, separate entrance for easy ADU possibilities, separate laundry & en Suite Master (up & down) to name a few. Just steps from Cap Hill Light Rail, Volunteer Park, Bus line, Broadway & More. Do Come See! No showings till Sunday open 4-7 PM

Accepting all offers. Welcome to Arboretum Hills, in North Capitol Hill. Where a flourishing canopy and sweeping views unfold from room to room. A living panorama stretches across Lake WA, Bellevue skyline, and Mt. Rainier. Rich, dark floors meet creamy white walls, a refined backdrop for flow, function, style and form. The expansive chef's kitchen pairs elevated appliances, generous cabinetry and striking black stone countertops. The inviting living room and cozy fireplace make relaxing and entertaining effortless, while a wall of windows draws in natural light and frames this 1900s Craftsman. Gather by the fire, linger over game night, or retreat downstairs for a movie. Upstairs, the primary suite is pure indulgence: a private sitting room for slow mornings, a walk-in closet and beautifully appointed bath made for unwinding, plus an additional bedroom and bathroom. A bedroom, office and full bath open directly to the level backyard, a private canvas for gardens and gatherings. The lower level adds a guest bedroom, full bath, play and media room, laundry and an oversized workshop with abundant storage. Systems have been modernized, and fresh paint makes moving in easy. Mere steps from Seattle's treasured Arboretum, yet central to it all. Linger over brunch in Madison Valley, stock your kitchen at the new PCC on Madison Ave, and end the night with dinner on 19th. Immersed in nature and connected to the city, it feels like a private retreat. Welcome home to Arboretum Hills.

Tucked along one of Broadmoor's most coveted streets, this grand mid-century home is a rare glimpse into an era when architecture was designed to bring people, light, and landscape together. Lovingly maintained by the same family for decades, the home retains an unmistakable sense of place-thoughtful proportions, warm original details, and expansive glass that invites the outdoors in. At the heart of the home, a dramatic two-story living room rises beneath a wall of windows, framing views across the Broadmoor golf course and capturing the soft easterly light. It is a space made for lingering: morning coffee overlooking the fairways, long dinners with friends, or quiet evenings as the landscape changes beyond the glass. The den offers a more intimate expression of mid-century design, with a sunken conversation area centered around a fireplace and surrounded by built-in bookshelves. Outside, the pool, private entry courtyard, and generous grounds create a private setting for summer afternoons and easy entertaining. With a two-car garage, a peaceful residential setting, and Madison Park a short distance away, the location is as effortless as the architecture is distinctive. A home with soul, history, and an enduring connection to its surroundings-ready for its next chapter.

New Greencity home on Capitol Hill with an attached garage and a private rooftop deck, a few blocks from Volunteer Park. The garage opens into the house, so you park once and skip the hunt for a street spot. One floor up, kitchen, dining and living share one open level lit by large windows, so cooking and company happen in the same room. Quartz counters clean up fast, soft-close two-tone cabinetry keeps the kitchen quiet and organized, and the stainless appliances are included. Wide-plank flooring runs through every room and is easy to keep clean. The next floor holds the secondary bedrooms and a full bath with a tub, a good setup for guests, an office or both. The primary suite has the fourth floor to itself, so it stays quiet when the rest of the house is busy. Its bath has dual sinks and a glass-enclosed shower tiled to the ceiling, and the walk-in closet and laundry are on the same floor, right where the clothes are. Up top, the rooftop deck spans the home, with room for a dining table, loungers and planters under open sky. Ductless mini-splits heat and cool room by room, which keeps the upper floors comfortable in summer. Double-pane windows hold that comfort in, and Cat 6 wiring gives a home office a reliable wired connection. The home is backed by a builder warranty. Broadway's restaurants, bakeries, coffee and QFC Broadway Market are close, and the Capitol Hill light rail station connects you to downtown and UW without the drive. Seattle Public Schools.

text: There's living in Seattle, and then there's living in the middle of it all. This new construction collection by Garton Developments puts you right in the heart of Capitol Hill, with modern interiors, incredible rooftop views and one of the city's best neighborhoods just beyond your front door. Bright, open living spaces are framed by oversized windows and finished with quartz surfaces, stainless steel appliances and a crisp, contemporary palette. In select homes, a mezzanine creates an unexpected extra layer of living space-set up the home office, reading nook, record room or whatever fits your life. The rooftop is where things really come together.
